name: container-gap
note: Documented @container gap, divergence side: an ancestor DOES establish a container (container-type: inline-size, width 400px), so Chrome's @container (min-width: 100px) matches and paints #child red. The engine's @container evaluation model parses this query but layout does not yet resolve container sizes, so the rule is never applied and #child stays black. This fixture is authored with expected computedStyle: 'fail' to prove the divergence is real and documented — the check passes only when Chrome and the engine disagree exactly as the ledger describes. See docs/ledgers/media-queries.md.
